'''Chapter 1179''' is titled "Nerona Imu Descends".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page]] Request: "[[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]] and [[Kurozumi Tama|O-Tama]] and [[Yamato]] leading boar piglets on a hike down a wetlands path!!" by Naoyama Wants to Travel

==Short Summary==
The [[Five Elders]] have great unease about [[Imu]] going down to the surface world, but the ruler sees no other choice given the machinations of history. As the Straw Hats collect themselves following their subjugation of the [[Knights of God]], they witness Imu arriving at [[Aurust Castle]], with the [[Abyss]] surrounding it with large black flames and bringing the trees and buildings to life. Using the power [[Akuma no Mi]], Imu heads to the castle roof as he is revealed to be Nerona Imu, one of the [[First Twenty]] and the King of the World.

==Long Summary==
The [[Five Elders]] realize [[Nerona Imu|Imu]] plans on going to [[Elbaph]] by himself and try to convince him not to, but [[Figarland Garling|Garling]] walks in and chides them for their arrogance in assuming the Holy Land will remain secure, admitting that while [[Figarland Shamrock|Shamrock]]'s return has stabilized the current situation, the [[Revolutionary Army]]'s starvation tactic is working and they were fools to think it would not. Instead of maintaining their pride and dignity, they need the most powerful military they can create to keep the world under their control, but his conversation is interrupted by [[Vegapunk/York|York]], who calls to complain about the lack of food. Garling reminds her that he warned her about the situation, and if she wants it to stop, she needs to hurry up and reproduce the [[Mother Flame]]. York continues to complain, but Garling tells her that as one of [[Vegapunk|Dr. Vegapunk]]'s creations, she needs to take responsibility for his actions before hanging up.

Garling says that ever since "[[Nika]]" showed up, [[Mary Geoise]] has been plagued with constant disaster, and wonders if this is an act of fate or mere coincidence. Regardless, the Elders try to change Imu's mind, suggesting they send an [[Admiral]] instead, but [[Ethanbaron V. Nusjuro|Nusjuro]] says they cannot with what trouble they currently have. [[Topman Warcury|Warcury]] then suggests they themselves go, but Imu denies this, saying they must cast away their arrogance, sloth, and pride, for everything that is happening was already set in motion. All the while, he thinks about [[Rocks D. Xebec|Rocks]]' promise to return, [[Gol D. Roger|Roger]]'s execution, [[Shanks]]' theft of the [[Gomu Gomu no Mi]], [[Shirahoshi]]'s birth, the knowledge of [[Loki]]'s [[Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhöggr|Devil Fruit]], and the existence of [[Monkey D. Luffy]] and [[Marshall D. Teach|Blackbeard]]. Imu demands to know why "[[Joy Boy]]" and "[[Davy D. Jones|Davy Jones]]" continue to make him suffer since all he wants is [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]], as he proceeds to prepare an [[Abyss]] to travel to Elbaph. Garling says they cannot stop him, which the other four elders reluctantly acknowledge.

In Elbaph, [[Gerd]] brings [[Shepherd Sommers|Sommers]], who is cut in half and restrained with rope, and shows how his separated parts are trying to link together to [[Hajrudin]], calling it creepy. [[Goldberg]] shows Sommers' heart, which is made of steel, and [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] wonders if destroying it will kill Sommers for good, which scares him. At the [[Owl Library]], [[Franky]] looks after the unconscious [[Usopp]] and [[Brook]] while [[Jinbe]] tries looking for [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]]. [[Rimoshifu Killingham|Killingham]] is also tied up and his parts hanging from a tree by [[Sanji]]. Killingham angrily tells Sanji that he will remember his name, and demands him remembering his, but Sanji says he forgot. As for [[Manmayer Gunko|Gunko]], the ice she is incased in starts to crack.

Meanwhile, Loki, Luffy, and [[Ragnir]] go to the Walrus School to get some food and are surprised that it is frozen by [[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith]]'s invention. Loki complains that the frozen food tastes bad but the trio ate it anyways. Luffy, despite his withered state, tries to get food to Usopp and Brook, to which Loki quips that Luffy should've recover himself first. Luffy asks Loki if Gunko is dead in the ice, and he explains that she is not, but only Ragnir can thaw the ice she is stuck in.

Off in the distance, [[Nami]] sees something, and in an instant, a five pillars of black energy erupts above [[Aurust Castle]], creating an Abyss Circle above it. The energy emitted brings the nearby houses and trees to life as they start making noise. Then, the sixth pillar of black energy then appears straight in the middle of the castle, unleashing a wave of [[Haki/Supreme King Haki|Supreme King Haki]] that knocks out several people. Imu appears at the summoning spot inside the throne room, falls to his knees and coughs up blood. Imu then transforms as he screams in great pain, resulting in an explosion through the roof of the castle, to everyone, even Sommers' and Killingham's, shock.

As Imu sits on top of castle, finally shown in his full form, it is revealed that Imu is in fact, Nerona Imu; one of the [[First Twenty]] and founder of the [[World Government]], and possessing the power of the [[Akuma no Mi]].

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
<!-- Do not add until official English release -->
*The situation in [[Mary Geoise]] was stabilized by [[Figarland Shamrock]]'s return but the [[Revolutionary Army]]'s food blockade is still active.
**[[Vegapunk/York|York]] has a lab in Mary Geoise and is continuing work on the [[Mother Flame]].
*[[Nerona Imu|Imu]] travels to [[Aurust Castle]] via an enormous [[Abyss]] that emanates [[Haki/Supreme King Haki|Supreme King Haki]].
**Surrounding buildings and trees come alive and manifest [[Demons|demonic]] faces.
**This process cause Imu to fall to his knees and cough up blood.
*Sommers' heart is discovered to be made of steel, with Zoro theorizing that destroying it could permanently kill Sommers, a notion that visibly frightens Sommers.
*[[Loki]] confirms that [[Manmayer Gunko|Gunko]] is alive and claims that the ice can be melted only by [[Ragnir]].
*Imu's face is shown for the first time, and he is officially introduced as Saint Nerona Imu, the [[Royal#King|King of the World]], one of the [[First Twenty]], and wielder of the [[Akuma no Mi]], a [[Devil Fruit]] whose name literally means "The Devil's Fruit".
